card.name: Chapter and verse numbers in John citations
card.fires_on: The colon or verse digit inside a Bible citation, mostly after John 17 (also John 1, Luke 8, 1 Peter 3). It fires in theological prose where a reference is being given.

modes.label: Colon after chapter
modes.description: The colon between chapter and verse in a scripture reference.

modes.label: Verse digit

card.writes: Suppresses words for Jesus and his disciples, so it steers away from naming Jesus or the apostles right after a citation.
card.plain: It lights up on the punctuation and numbers inside Bible references such as John 17:17.
